newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Saurer sees 1996 EBIT around 80 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Saurer sees 1996 EBIT around 80 mln Sfr.

text.p: Swiss textile and automotive fittings company Saurer Group Holding AG expects 1996 earnings before interest and taxes of around 80 million Swiss francs, Chairman Ernst Thomke told a meeting of financial analysts.
Saurer had said in September it saw EBIT at around 70 million in 1996, up from a loss of 58 million in 1995.
Thomke said 1996 sales should dip to around 1.64 billion Swiss francs. Saurer posted a group loss of 75.2 million francs in 1995 on sales of 1.73 billion.
In a subsequent statement, Saurer quoted Thomke as saying operating profit before provisions would exceed 80 million francs in 1996.
"In addition, it was announced that the additional need for provisions for restructuring measures to be conducted in the next two years will not surpass 25 million francs," it said.
